title: The Medium Is the Connection
summary: A museum wall label whose medium line is your live network connection, governing how much of a single fixed Ryman-white painting is served despite zero bytes ever being transmitted.
mechanism: navigator.connection (Network Information API: effectiveType, downlink, rtt, saveData) with its change event sets how many of a seeded 1,200-stroke canvas painting render; browsers that withhold the API read 'undisclosed' and serve a default; no network, no storage.
references: Marshall McLuhan, Understanding Media: the medium is the message (1964)
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
